entries.zh: 走暗路；走上凶险的歧途、处境不妙
entries.en: to walk a dark road; to be on a bad path, in a bad situation
entries.notes: H『暗三路』字面为暗中的岔路，与 L mal passo（险途/困境）义相合，『三』字待考。

entries.en: to go to and fro; to walk hither and thither
entries.notes: L 末尾『ad2』疑为原稿参见标记，未详，不影响词义。

entries.zh: 上上下下地走，来回上下
entries.en: to go up and down
entries.notes: L『deassi ba』当为 de arriba abajo（上下）之讹写，H 行上行落 可证。

entries.zh: 走错路；不归正道、不回头
entries.en: to walk the wrong road; to go astray, not to turn aside
entries.notes: H 箸/著 形近致疑；M m̄ tĭo 即『不著（不对）』，正合 L no apartar。

entries.zh: 迷路，走投无路；误入歧途（道德上）
entries.en: to lose one's way, to be at a loss; to go morally astray
entries.notes: L 末『moralix.』疑为 moralmente（道德上）之缩写。

entries.zh: 靠一边走，走僻静的一侧
entries.en: to walk aside; to keep to one side
entries.notes: L『desejados』疑为 desviados（偏离）之讹，H 行僻一邊 相合。

entries.zh: 走江闯海的人，出海行商者
entries.en: seafaring trader; one who travels the rivers and seas
entries.notes: L『ma×cader』残损，疑为 mercader（商人）；H 行江海人 可定其义。

entries.en: one who roams the rivers and lakes; a wanderer
entries.notes: L 全句讹误（embercados porqua 疑涉 embarcados por agua），依 H 行江湖人 定谳。

entries.en: to travel by sea
to walk a straight path
entries.notes: L『del rayo』与 H 直、M chīt 不合，疑为 derecho/recto（笔直）之讹或喻笔直如矢。

entries.zh: 出外行旅；走去做买卖、交涉
entries.en: to travel abroad; to go about one's business or trade
to walk briskly, with long strides
to hurry along, to bustle

entries.zh: 趋奉，奔走侍奉，殷勤伺候
entries.en: to hasten to serve; to attend upon diligently
to hurry with great haste
entries.notes: H 作趨趕，而 M/R 两栏均记 chû chû（趨趨），栏间不合，姑取『急趋』义。

entries.zh: 急走，躁急（原字残损，义难定）
entries.en: to walk in haste; hasty, restless
entries.notes: M 栏有 [残] 且声调 T99；L『clerico - sobrino』文义不通，疑旁注掺入，仅取 apriessa 急行一义。

entries.en: to turn, to revolve (of a wheel)
entries.notes: M 栏多出 tī 一音而 R 栏无对应，未详。

entries.en: to turn past; to go round
entries.notes: L 末『pasando amo p. baylan 8』讹误难读，仅取 pasando（经过）义。

entries.en: to turn and change; to alternate, to be exchanged
to boil, to bubble (of stews and juices)
entries.notes: L 疑为 los guisos/jugos bullendo（羹汤滚沸），H 泉/煮 二字待定。

entries.zh: 爬行，匍匐（手脚并用，拖身而行）
entries.en: to crawl on all fours, to drag oneself along
entries.notes: L 疑为 andar a gatas, arrastrándose；H 甭/甬 形近难定，M Bōn 待考。

entries.en: [original damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: L 仅存 andar agoras，H 甭甭 承上条而字形待定，M Bōn pô 无从定夺。
